strongest_bounded_proposition: Chattel slavery was legally institutionalized and practiced in substantial parts of the United States around 1800, with important regional legal differences.
strongest_unsupported_proposition: Do not represent the entire United States as one homogeneous slavery-practice/legal-status condition.
territorial_practice_summary: Enslaved labour and slaveholding directly supported in slaveholding regions.
legal_state_summary: Slavery remained legally recognized in many states while northern gradual abolition trajectories differed.
external_network_summary: Trade connections remain separate from local practice.
temporal_scope_precision: Bounded to cited evidence; sample interval is not itself slavery evidence.
evidence_locus: United States with required regional differentiation
inference_extent: Subnational practice supported; national uniformity rejected.
language_access_limitations: English-accessible packet only; non-English/non-digitized scholarship not exhaustively searched.
